metas.name: Microcosmos
metas.description:
Captures a meadow as an alien world, at insect scale. One day in a French field, almost no narration: snails mating, a dung beetle rolling its ball uphill, rain arriving like artillery.

A documentary on insect life in meadows and ponds.

metas.name: Jiro Dreams of Sushi
metas.description:
Captures mastery as repetition across a lifetime. An 85-year-old with a tiny Tokyo subway sushi counter and three Michelin stars, sons waiting to inherit, and a standard of 'delicious' he says he still hasn't reached.

A documentary on 85-year-old sushi master Jiro Ono, his renowned Tokyo restaurant, and his relationship with his son and eventual heir, Yoshikazu.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description:
Captures decency as something contagious. A bear framed for stealing the pop-up book he wanted to buy his aunt, sent to prison — and the prison improves because he is in it.

Paddington, now happily settled with the Brown family and a popular member of the local community, picks up a series of odd jobs to buy the perfect present for his Aunt Lucy's 100th birthday, only for the gift to be stolen.

metas.name: Timbuktu
metas.description:
Captures occupation resisted through music, football and dignity. Jihadists take a Malian town and ban singing and soccer; people comply in public, sing quietly at night, and play a match with an invisible ball.

A cattle herder and his family who reside in the dunes of Timbuktu find their quiet lives -- which are typically free of the Jihadists determined to control their faith -- abruptly disturbed.

metas.name: The Tale of the Princess Kaguya
metas.description:
Captures joy being disciplined out of a girl. A bamboo cutter raises a moon princess and watches court life sand down the wild child she was, until the watercolour lines themselves start to run.

Kaguya is a beautiful young woman coveted by five nobles. To try to avoid marrying a stranger she doesn't love, she sends her suitors on seemingly impossible tasks. But she will have to face her fate and punishment for her choices.

metas.name: The Ballad of Narayama
metas.description:
Captures a folk custom at full earthiness. Imamura's mountain village carries its old people up the peak to die at seventy, filmed with his usual gusto for sex, cruelty and teeming nature — ritual without a trace of reverence.

In a poor 19th century rural Japanese village, everyone who reaches the age of 70 has to climb a nearby mountain to die. An elderly woman is reaching close to her cut-off age during her last days with her family.

metas.name: Alice
metas.description:
Captures the folk tale as a child's-eye inventory of a household's dangerous things. Švankmajer's Alice moves through a Wonderland of taxidermy, bones and jam jars of pins, stop-motion objects that genuinely threaten her — Carroll's dream rebuilt from junk drawers.

A surrealistic revision of Alice in Wonderland.
